text:
alex_cs: Heads-up — signed renewal landed for RowanHealth (executed today). Procurement says they'll pay via PO Net45 but procurement needs vendor code fix and that may take ~3 weeks. Customer asked that we provision seats and schedule enablement before PO clears. What's the fastest safe path to provision while keeping finance/legal covered? cc @tariq_fin

jess_onboard: Congrats team! We can provision dev/training seats on the existing CC while PO is outstanding if finance/legal ok with an interim SOW addendum. Suggest 2x 90-min enablement sessions next Tue/Wed to keep the ramp.

tariq_fin: Finance note — vendor code fix is the blocker, procurement estimates ~3 weeks. We can allow provisional provisioning if customer signs short amendment that covers interim billing and reconciliation. Need AE written approval and a clear billing owner.

samantha_ae: I'll ask the customer for written interim approval now (email). Pushing procurement to expedite. If they approve in email we can proceed.

legal_bot: FYI — if we provision before PO, we should use this language in the amendment to avoid revenue recognition issues. I'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum.

alex_cs: Please paste the draft language here when ready. Also confirm what we can provision without a PO (seats, training only; no usage overages).

tariq_fin: Draft snippet pasted below:

```
Customer authorizes interim provisioning while procurement completes PO. Customer agrees to invoice settlement within Net45 upon PO receipt. Any charges incurred during the interim period will be offset against the first invoice issued after PO confirmation.
```

We still need a signed nod from the customer. No overage billing until PO is issued.

jess_onboard: Proposed training windows: 2024-06-04 10:00 PT (90m) and 2024-06-05 14:00 PT (90m). Can we lock those? @rowan_admin please confirm attendee availability.

rowan_admin: We can confirm 6/4 10a PT. 6/5 is tentative but likely OK. Procurement will send interim approval email now and the PO within ~3 weeks.

samantha_ae: Customer just sent the approval email — forwarding to @tariq_fin. Alex, please provision seats and label as provisional billing.

alex_cs: Done — provisioned 25 seats, set temporary billing to CC ending ****4242 (exp 08/25), created ticket CS-3982 with note: "RowanHealth provisional provisioning — pending PO 1716339". jess_onboard, you have access.

jess_onboard: Got access and will send calendar invites + prework. Reminder: training credits tracked under the renewal addendum.

tariq_fin: Once PO arrives we'll convert/offset interim charges on the invoice and close the loop. Legal, please route the amendment via DocuSign.

legal_bot: Draft sent to customer via DocuSign (https://docusign.example/abc123). Please follow up with the customer if you don't see signature in 48h.

alex_cs: TL;DR action list — 1) jess send invites and prework, 2) legal follow up DocuSign, 3) tariq reconcile after PO arrives, 4) sam monitor procurement cadence and escalate if >3w. If procurement slips we'll extend provisional provision 1 week and notify Rowan. :thumbsup:
